title.narrative: Contributo Volontario 2025 OCSE Centro di Caserta
OECD Voluntary Contribution 2025 - Caserta Training Centre

description.narrative: Contributo volontario alle attività del Centro di Formazione OCSE sulla Governance Pubblica nell'area del Medio Oriente e Nord Africa, Africa Sub-Sahariana, Balcani Occidentali e Ucraina. Il contributo finanziario fornito dal donatore sarà utilizzato dall'OCSE per l'attuazione delle attività del Centro di Formazione OCSE sulla Governance Pubblica in conformità con il Piano di Lavoro Annuale approvato dal Consiglio di Gestione ai sensi delle disposizioni dell'articolo 5 de "l'Accordo". In particolare attività di formazione, capacity building e dialogo politico della durata di più giorni, organizzate in collaborazione con il Centro di formazione sulla governance pubblica dell’OCSE e che si svolgeranno nella sede della SNA a Caserta. Il contributo è coerente con l'Obiettivo di Sviluppo Sostenibile 17 (SDG 17), in particolare con i target 17.2, 17.9, 17.14, 17.16, 17.18 e 17.19.

Voluntary contribution to the activities of the OECD Training Centre on Public Governance in the Middle East and North Africa area, Sub-Saharan Africa, Western Balkans and Ukraine. The financial contribution provided by the donor will be used by OECD for the implementation of the activities of the OECD Training Centre on Public Governance according to the Annual Work Plan approved by the Management Board under the provisions of article 5 of “the Agreement”. In particolare attività di formazione, capacity building e dialogo politico della durata di più giorni, organizzate in collaborazione con il Centro di formazione sulla governance pubblica dell’OCSE e che si svolgeranno nella sede della SNA a Caserta. The contribution is consistent with SDG 17, particularly target 17.2, 17.9, 17.14, 17.16, 17.18 e 17.19.

tag.narrative: By 2020, enhance capacity-building support to developing countries, including for least developed countries and small island developing States, to increase significantly the availability of high-quality, timely and reliable data disaggregated by income, gender, age, race, ethnicity, migratory status, disability, geographic location and other characteristics relevant in national contexts

By 2030, build on existing initiatives to develop measurements of progress on sustainable development that complement gross domestic product, and support statistical capacity-building in developing countries

Developed countries to implement fully their official development assistance commitments, including the commitment by many developed countries to achieve the target of 0.7 per cent of gross national income for official development assistance (ODA/GNI) to developing countries and 0.15 to 0.20 per cent of ODA/GNI to least developed countries; ODA providers are encouraged to consider setting a target to provide at least 0.20 per cent of ODA/GNI to least developed countries

Enhance international support for implementing effective and targeted capacity-building in developing countries to support national plans to implement all the Sustainable Development Goals, including through North-South, South-South and triangular cooperation
Enhance policy coherence for sustainable development

Enhance the Global Partnership for Sustainable Development, complemented by multi-stakeholder partnerships that mobilize and share knowledge, expertise, technology and financial resources, to support the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals in all countries, in particular developing countries
Strengthen the means of implementation and revitalize the global partnership for sustainable development
